dogecoin.text: @wallstreetbets Those were times... Those who got in the bitcoin presale using dogecoin must regret now.
Can't believe that I mentioned dogecoin in the same post as NOIA. Makes me smash my phone. 🤦🏻‍♂️

I was often worried that bitcoin and alts would dump hard due to an SEC crackdown, regulations, rug pulls and all sorts of FUD.

Not even in my wildest dreams would I have thought that it would dump and flow into Dogecoin. You just can't make this up. 🤦🏻‍♂️🤷🏻‍♂️
